name: Alarm

components.material: a tiny bell and a piece of fine silver wire

description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion within a 20-foot cube area. Choose mental or audible alert. The alarm sounds when a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area (up to 8 hours).

name: Animal Friendship

components.material: a morsel of food

description: You convince a Beast with an Intelligence of 3 or lower that you mean no harm. The beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Charmed by you for 24 hours. If you or your allies harm it, the spell ends.

name: Armor of Agathys

components.material: a cup of water

description: A protective magical force surrounds you, granting 5 Temporary Hit Points. Until the spell ends, whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 5 cold damage. Higher levels: +5 temp HP and +5 cold damage per slot level above 1st.

name: Bane

components.material: a drop of blood

description: Up to 3 creatures of your choice within range must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or subtract a d4 from each attack roll and saving throw they make for the duration. Higher levels: +1 creature per slot level above 1st.

name: Bless

components.material: a sprinkling of holy water

description: You bless up to 3 creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it adds a d4 to the roll. Higher levels: +1 creature per slot level above 1st.

name: Burning Hands
description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failed save or half on a success. Higher levels: +1d6 per slot level above 1st.

name: Charm Person
description: You attempt to charm a Humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure, it is Charmed by you for the duration and regards you as a friendly acquaintance. The charm ends if you or your allies harm it. Higher levels: +1 target per slot level above 1st.

name: Chromatic Orb

components.material: a diamond worth at least 50 gp

description: You hurl a 4-inch-diameter sphere of energy at a creature in range. You choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder damage. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, deal 3d8 damage of the chosen type. Higher levels: +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Color Spray

components.material: a pinch of powder or sand in red, yellow, and blue

description: A dazzling array of flashing, colored light springs from your hand. Roll 6d10; the total determines which creatures in the cone are Blinded by this spell, starting from the creature with the lowest current HP (ignoring unconscious and sightless creatures). Higher levels: +2d10 per slot level above 1st.

name: Command
description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The command must be a single word such as Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, or Halt. Higher levels: +1 creature per slot level above 1st.

name: Comprehend Languages

components.material: a pinch of soot and salt

description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear and can read any written language you see, though you must be touching the surface the words are written on.

name: Cure Wounds
description: A creature you touch regains 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points. Higher levels: +2d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Detect Magic
description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. If you sense magic, you can use your action to see a faint aura around any visible creature or object bearing magic and learn its school of magic, if any.

name: Disguise Self
description: You make yourself — including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings — look different until the spell ends. You can appear up to 1 foot shorter or taller, thin, fat, or in between. The disguise must have the same basic arrangement of limbs.

name: Dissonant Whispers
description: You whisper a discordant melody to a creature within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d6 psychic damage and must use its reaction to move as far away from you as possible; on a success, it takes half damage and doesn't move. Higher levels: +1d6 per slot level above 1st.

name: Entangle
description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square within range. Each creature in that area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be Restrained for the duration. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to free itself.

name: Faerie Fire
description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Creatures in the area that fail a Dexterity saving throw are also outlined. Outlined objects and creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. Attack rolls against outlined creatures have advantage.

name: Feather Fall

components.material: a small feather or a piece of down

description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If the creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage and can land on its feet.

name: Find Familiar

components.material: 10 gp worth of charcoal, incense, and herbs consumed as incense

description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes the form of a beast you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, seahorse, spider, or weasel. The familiar acts independently but always obeys your commands.

name: Fog Cloud
description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range. The sphere spreads around corners, and its area is Heavily Obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it. Higher levels: radius increases by 20 feet per slot level above 1st.

name: Goodberry

components.material: a sprig of mistletoe

description: Up to 10 berries appear in your hand, infused with magic. A creature can use its action to eat one berry, restoring 1 Hit Point and providing enough nourishment to sustain a creature for one day. The berries lose their potency after 24 hours.

name: Grease

components.material: a bit of pork rind or butter

description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range. That area becomes Difficult Terrain. Each creature standing in the area when the grease appears must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone.

name: Guiding Bolt
description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has advantage. Higher levels: +1d6 per slot level above 1st.

name: Healing Word
description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains 2d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier Hit Points. Higher levels: +2d4 per slot level above 1st.

name: Hellish Rebuke
description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failed save or half on a success. Higher levels: +1d10 per slot level above 1st.

name: Hex

components.material: the petrified eye of a newt

description: You place a curse on a creature within range. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack, and the target has disadvantage on ability checks with one ability you choose when you cast this spell. If the target drops to 0 HP, you can use a bonus action to curse a new creature. Higher levels: duration increases (8 hours at 3rd–4th level, 24 hours at 5th+).

name: Hunter's Mark
description: You choose a creature within range and magically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage whenever you hit the marked target with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it. If the target drops to 0 HP, you can use a bonus action to mark a new creature. Higher levels: duration increases.

name: Identify

components.material: a pearl worth at least 100 gp and an owl feather

description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement, and how many charges it has. You also learn whether any spells are affecting it.

name: Inflict Wounds
description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 2d10 necrotic damage. Higher levels: +1d10 per slot level above 1st.

name: Jump

components.material: a grasshopper's hind leg

description: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

name: Longstrider

components.material: a pinch of dirt

description: You touch a creature. Its speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends. Higher levels: +1 creature per slot level above 1st.

name: Mage Armor

components.material: a piece of cured leather

description: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. Until the spell ends, the target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss it as an action.

name: Magic Missile
description: You create three glowing darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4+1 force damage to a target of your choice within range. All darts strike simultaneously, and you can direct them at the same target or at different ones. Higher levels: +1 dart per slot level above 1st.

name: Protection from Evil and Good

components.material: holy water or powdered silver and iron, which the spell consumes

description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead. They can't possess, charm, or frighten the target, and the target has advantage on saving throws against their spells and special abilities.

name: Sanctuary

components.material: a small silver mirror

description: You ward a creature within range against attack. Until the spell ends, any creature who targets the warded creature with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must choose a new target or lose its attack or spell. The ward ends if the warded creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature.

name: Shield
description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you. Until the start of your next turn, you have a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack, and you take no damage from Magic Missile.

name: Shield of Faith

components.material: a small parchment with a holy text inscribed on it

description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

name: Silent Image

components.material: a bit of fleece

description: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon no larger than a 15-foot cube. You can use your action to move it anywhere within range and change its appearance. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

name: Sleep

components.material: a pinch of fine sand, rose petals, or a cricket

description: You send creatures into a magical slumber. Roll 5d8; the total is how many HP of creatures this spell can affect within 20 feet of a chosen point, starting with the creature with the lowest current HP. Each creature affected falls Unconscious until the spell ends, it takes damage, or someone uses an action to wake it. Higher levels: +2d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Speak with Animals
description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with Beasts for the duration. The knowledge and awareness of many Beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum a Beast can give you information about nearby locations and monsters.

name: Tasha's Hideous Laughter

components.material: tiny tarts and a feather that is waved in the air

description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or fall Prone and become Incapacitated (unable to stand), laughing until the spell ends. At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, it can make another Wisdom saving throw to end the effect.

name: Thunderwave
description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you; on a success, it takes half damage and isn't pushed. Higher levels: +1d8 per slot level above 1st.

name: Unseen Servant

components.material: a piece of string and a bit of wood

description: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless, Medium force that performs simple tasks at your command. It can move objects, open unlocked doors, hold torches, and so on, but it can't attack or take actions that require a spell or specific creature feature.

name: Witch Bolt

components.material: a twig from a tree that has been struck by lightning

description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range, forming a sustained arc of lightning. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the target takes 2d12 lightning damage. On each of your turns, you can use your action to deal 1d12 lightning damage to the target automatically. The spell ends if you use your action to do anything else or if the target is ever more than 30 feet from you. Higher levels: initial hit damage increases by 1d12 per slot level above 1st.

name: Wrathful Smite
description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage. Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must make a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened of you until the spell ends. As an action, the frightened target can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect.
